name: Patanjali Foods Ltd.
business_summary: Former Ruchi Soya: India's large edible-oil refiner/marketer (Ruchi Gold, Mahakosh, Nutrela, Patanjali brand oils) plus food & FMCG (biscuits, atta, ghee, honey, soya chunks) and, per model knowledge, home & personal care acquired from Patanjali Ayurved, and oil-palm plantations. Revenue FY26 Rs 40,170 cr at a very thin 4.4% EBITDA margin, so profit depends on the refining spread, inventory gains/losses from import-duty changes and a growing food mix. Q1 FY27 sales Rs 11,337 cr (+29%), PAT Rs 336 cr (+86%). Q2 FY27 results not yet reported at 5 Nov 2026.

cost_structure.note: crude palm/soy/sunflower oil and oilseeds, approximate

exposures.mechanism: Duty differential between crude and refined oil protects refiners; a duty rise lifts domestic price and revalues ~30-45 days of inventory (~Rs 3,000 cr, approximate). +5pp effective duty => landed cost +~4% => inventory gain ~Rs 120 cr on EBITDA of Rs 1,762 cr (FY26) => +7%; spreads widen too; persistence 0.5; EV/MCap 1.1 => ~+3.5. A cut does the reverse: shares fell after the 24 Sep 2026 cut (Zee Business), consistent in sign.

evidence.note: Zee Business: Patanjali Foods, AWL Agri under pressure as centre cuts edible oil import duty

exposures.mechanism: Sells oil at near cost-plus: rising global oil raises sales and gives inventory gains (positive, ~Rs 300 cr per +10% on ~Rs 3,000 cr stock = EBITDA +17%) but squeezes working capital and demand. Net +1.5 after demand loss and persistence 0.25; range wide, sign uncertain. No significant empirical link.

Crude oil imports are USD-priced (~60% of costs); domestic price parity passes most through, but payables/hedging lag. +3% INR weakness => cost +1.9% vs pass-through 80% => EBITDA about -9% (thin 4.4% margin; unhedged 20% x 1.9% = 0.4pp of margin) x persistence 0.25 x EV/MCap 1.1 => about -0.8. Empirical USDCNY +7.8 (t=3.4) is a spurious proxy.

Food & FMCG and oil retail sales skew to semi-urban/rural stores. +5pp rural => volumes +2% => with 5% margin and 30% incremental margin on Food EBITDA, EBITDA +8% x 0.5 persistence x 0.4 oil share-hedge => +1.5.

evidence.note: Moneycontrol: Patanjali Foods rises on FY27 growth targets

exposures.mechanism: Food/HPC mix shifting to modern trade; +5pp urban => EBITDA +3% x 0.5 persistence x 0.5 => +0.8.

MP FDA ordered a cow-ghee batch recall (24 Oct) and Maharashtra FDA acted against a distributor (company statement 3 Nov, test results pending). Stricter enforcement => recall costs and brand damage; ghee ~5% of sales; +1 => EBITDA -3% plus a multiple penalty; probability-weighted => -1.5.

evidence.note: Telangana Today: MP FDA orders Patanjali Foods to recall cow ghee batch
TradingView: company says action directed at distributor

exposures.mechanism: Working-capital debt (interest Rs 41 cr/quarter) plus P/E 20: +25bp => interest +Rs 1-2 cr per quarter negligible; valuation channel -0.6.

evidence.note: interest Rs 41 cr in Jun-26 quarter

exposures.mechanism: Packaged foods (biscuits, ghee, honey) moved to lower GST slabs in Sept 2025 (model knowledge); further cut helps Food & FMCG volumes: +1 => Food EBITDA +5% x 0.4 weight x 0.5 persistence... => +0.8.
Bottles/pouches/tins ~4% of costs: +10% => costs +0.4% of sales-equivalent; 70% pass-through leaves 0.12pp of a 4.4% margin (-2.7% EBITDA) x persistence 0.25 x 1.1 => about -0.3.
